habitat: Humid tropical forests and forest edges
identification: An electric blue upper surface with dark borders; the underside is brown with eye spots.
fact: The luminous blue comes from microscopic structures in its wing scales that reflect light.
form: Representative form; individual colors and markings vary

photo.alt: Blue morpho photographed with wings spread in Ecuador, showing luminous blue wing fields, dark scalloped margins, and pale edge spots

elevation: Ecuador photograph locality recorded; elevation not verified
fieldNotes: The bright blue is structural color, created by the shape of wing scales.
A dark outer border makes the blue field stand out.
The brown underside can look very different from the open blue upper wings.
reflection: What changed when you looked from another angle?
